rules: Use Playfair Display for massive, editorial marketing headings only.
Use Manrope for dashboard headings, widget titles, and labels.
Always use 'tabular-nums' utility class in Tailwind for any financial metrics, budget engines, or ticketing numbers.
Never center align default text, prioritize optical left alignment.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Strictly limited. NO purple SaaS gradients. Use solid colors or barely perceptible linear gradients (e.g. 0A0A0A to 141414).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using neutral grays (#27272A). Avoid floating cards with heavy drop shadows; prefer flat, bounded regions.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid excessive use. Only use minimal backdrop-blur-md on sticky navigation or critical modal overlays.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix of near-black for structural backdrop, and warm ivory (#FDFBF7) used extremely sparingly for high-impact emphasis (e.g. a specific active ticket tier or high-contrast callout).

layouts.marketing: Asymmetrical bento grids with generous spacing (p-12, p-24). Avoid generic center alignment.
layouts.dashboard: High-density, strict grid hierarchy (Grid Mode B). Use sharp edges or max 8px border-radius. Avoid excessive spacing in data-heavy areas.
layouts.responsive: Perfect responsiveness required. Sidebars convert to drawers on mobile. Complex tables convert to stacked cards on mobile view.

motion.style: Smooth, fast, functional. No heavy/distracting animations.
motion.interactions: Transition on Event Graph nodes, funding gap meters, and modal/drawer toggles.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle 4px radius. High contrast text. Use Vermilion (#FF4500) for primary actions.
components.tables: Cardless design, plain rows divided by 1px borders. Left-aligned text, right-aligned tabular numbers.
components.drawers: Use for mobile sidebars and for quick-edit 'Run of Show' or 'Event Blueprint' sliding panels.
components.event_graph: Interactive node-edge visualization. Nodes should have status indicators (draft/pending/confirmed/blocked). Use 'react-force-graph-2d' or custom SVG logic for node edges.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React JS (.jsx / .js files), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI components (configured via Tailwind).
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Hybrid fullstack approach with dedicated views for Landing, Discover Portal, and Event Command Center/Dashboard.
rules: No Typescript. Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) for all components.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='budget-submit-btn').
DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe looking components for the marketing page. Use raw HTML+Tailwind for high-impact asymmetric layouts.
In the dashboard, use cardless flat lists, 1px borders, dense data presentation.
Use Shadcn UI components but strip excessive styles/shadows to match the 'uncluttered, corporate-ready' flat aesthetic.
Integrate Lucide React for consistent iconography. Use Phosphor Icons if more specialized dashboard icons are needed.
For financial modules (Budget engine, What-if simulator), implement dynamic tabular inputs and use `tabular-nums` class.
For Indonesian sandbox payments, mock the flow but provide distinct UI states for BCA/BRI/GoPay/OVO/QRIS selections.
For the Event Graph, use a lightweight graph library or CSS grids/SVG connections. Focus on node statuses: draft/pending/confirmed/missing/conflicted/at-risk/blocked.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered text, no simplistic gradients, no uniform sizing. Use extreme size contrast in headings.
NEVER use emojis as icons in the UI. Strictly use SVG/React icons.
All overlays/dropdowns/sticky headers MUST have a solid or slightly blurred background. NO fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided unsplash URLs.
